analysis.visual_description: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill in the tiring-house, before he goes on for his own afternoon. The title is the whole of the print. No man's name sits under it. He does not start for the river.
The bill, on the bookwheel. The sheet goes to the peg with the other bills he will not follow. His own plot is on the other peg. He turns to that.
